## Personal Interests & Hobbies

- **Hiking & Camping** — Hiked and summited 10 of Colorado's 58 peaks above 14,000 feet (4,267.2 meters), also known as [14ers](https://www.14ers.org/).
- **Fermented Foods & Beverages** — Regularly bake sourdough bread and pizza, and brew homemade [kombucha](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kombucha) tea.
- **Basketball** — Played basketball in Italy's top professional league and at the NCAA D-I level in college.
